title: FAIL — A Computational Audit of Randomized Two-Bin Stretching
description: Negative-result and soundness-audit package for a failed transfer in randomized online two-bin stretching. The package exactly reproduces the classic 7/6 Yao support and gives an exact offline-feasible diagnostic showing that a naive joint-state pruning/lifting rule does not certify the apparent 57/46 candidate. This record explicitly claims no new competitive-ratio bound.
notes: FROZEN NEGATIVE RESULT. NO_NEW_BOUND_CLAIMED. The counterexample targets only the audited naive joint-state pruning/lifting rule and is not a counterexample to the published randomized two-bin method.
